[SWS_CM_10299] Source of a SOME/IP request message
⌈
The SOME/IP re-
quest message shall use the unicast IP address defined in the Manifest by the
Ipv4Configuration/Ipv6Configuration attribute of the NetworkEndpoint
that is referenced (in role unicastNetworkEndpoint) by the EthernetCom-
municationConnector of a Machine which in turn is mapped to the Re-
quiredSomeipServiceInstance by means of a SomeipServiceInstance-
ToMachineMapping as source address for the transmission. The port number config-
ured via udpPort shall be used to derive the source port for the transmission in case
the selected transport protocol (see [SWS_CM_10298]) is UDP. If this port number is
configured to 0, an ephemeral port shall be used. If the port number is configured
to a value different from 0 exactly that port shall be used. The port number config-
ured via tcpPort shall be used to derive the source port for the transmission in case
the selected transport protocol (see [SWS_CM_10298]) is TCP. If this port number is
configured to 0, an ephemeral port shall be used. If the port number is configured to a
value different from 0 exactly that port shall be used.
⌋
